pc.notes: PC version 8: the Minecraft folder finder was rewritten -- it finds Bedrock's current data folder by itself instead of missing it. The mod check now covers eight add-ons, five of them with newer pack builds, plus the two new Vacuum Tubes packs.

phone.notes: Same app as 1.8 -- this pump is for the mods and the PC app. Five packs refreshed to their newest builds: Better Fishing, Ember Graves, Tunnel Bore, The Listener, and Hovercraft (these are the versions already fixed up in your worlds). Two new add-ons appear under Check for new mods: Vacuum Tubes (ride vacuum tubes between stations) and Vacuum Item Tubes (tubes that carry your items). PC Addon Adder is now version 8 with the fixed Minecraft folder finder.
